title: 16.42. Atītattika, Hetuduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Paccuppanno hetu dhammo naatītassa nahetussa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Paccuppanno hetu dhammo naanāgatassa nahetussa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Paccuppanno hetu dhammo naatītassa nahetussa ca naanāgatassa nahetussa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā cha, anantare tīṇi …pe… sahajāte tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
